titleText: JTF News: PBS NewsHour, BBC News
mainText: Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated that Cuba is a threat to the United States; Cuba's government accused him of making false statements.

titleText: JTF News: ABC News Australia, CBC News
mainText: Kyle Busch, a 2-time NASCAR champion, is dead at age 41.
The United States will send 5,000 additional troops to Poland, according to President Trump.
A crowd set fire to Ebola hospital tents in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
President Emmanuel Macron of France backs repeal of France's slavery laws.
